# finalproject

Final Project for BST 260 by Jeremiah Gorremuchu

Proposal:

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcfiremort`](https://jeremiah-pg.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcfiremort.md)
  : data from CDC on rates of mortality by firearm by state by year
- [`cdcmurd`](https://jeremiah-pg.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://jeremiah-pg.github.io/finalproject/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://jeremiah-pg.github.io/finalproject/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
